examples.trans: They have to be washed carefully by hand.
Put the glasses carefully on the table.

meanings.note: moving or capable of moving at high speed
+ infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)
adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.
Onion, salt, pepper — and that's all.
Chop the onion for the salad.

meanings.note: мелкими буквами = in small print / small letters

examples.trans: You don't read the small print.
There is only small change in my pocket.
Where do you get your meat?
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: to cut into portions or pieces
goes right before the word it negates

meanings.en: it is necessary, one needs to
meanings.note: + dative of the person + infinitive: мне нужно позвонить

examples.trans: I need to make a call.

meanings.note: to pound meat with a mallet
also political party or game of chess

examples.text: На столе стоял полный стакан воды.
examples.trans: A full glass of water stood on the table.

meanings.note: по порядку = in order; всё в порядке = everything is fine

examples.trans: Now let's go through everything in order.

приготовить.gloss: to prepare, to cook, to make

meanings.en: to cook, to make (food), to prepare

meanings.note: работать + instrumental = to work as: работать мэром

meanings.en: to cut, to slice, to carve

examples.trans: Cutting a living person with a knife!

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

следить.gloss: to watch, to follow; to keep an eye on

meanings.en: to look after, to keep an eye on

examples.trans: Keep an eye on the child.

meanings.note: в следующий раз = next time; следующий! = next, please!
спасибо за + accusative = thank you for

meanings.en: special, designed for a particular purpose

examples.trans: Calm down, the special operation continues.
A special tool is needed for this.

стараться.gloss: to try, to make an effort

meanings.en: to try hard, to make an effort

examples.trans: He always tries to help his friends.
We will sit together in a friendly way at the table.
That was a very subtle move.

examples.text: У нее тонкий вкус в искусстве.
examples.trans: She has delicate taste in art.

examples.text: Я точно не помню его адрес.
examples.trans: I don't remember his exact address.

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом
other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
